text: Manufacturing for this product has been discontinued. As an alternative, please refer to the F60, 850, F650 or 350 relays.
heading: Numerical Single-Phase and Three-Phase Reclosing System

text: The DRS is a multifunction microprocessor recloser system with a set of algorithms to perform distinct recloser single-phase and three-phase programs. The equipment has also incorporated the synchronism check and the voltage check functions. It may be applied with either one breaker or two breakers.
